payload.name: EIPA inhibition of SARS-CoV-2
payload.fact: The macropinocytosis inhibitor EIPA decreases SARS-CoV-2 RNA levels in cell culture supernatants.

provenance.title: A Simplified Quantitative Real-Time PCR Assay for Monitoring SARS-CoV-2 Growth in Cell Culture
provenance.quote_or_locus: Surprisingly, we found that the macropinocytosis inhibitor ethylisopropylamiloride (EIPA) similarly decreased SARS-CoV-2 RNA levels in supernatants
